title: BlueBlocks: Industry Sidechain Plugin Architecture
description:
Design plugin architecture for industry-specific sidechains.

## Architecture Overview

BlueBlocks main chain provides consensus and settlement.
Sidechains provide industry-specific functionality.

## Proposed Sidechains (Priority Order)

### P0: Healthcare Sidechain
- FHIR R4 resources
- HL7 v2 message processing
- Patient consent management
- Provider directory
- Compliance: HIPAA, HITECH

### P1: Insurance Sidechain
- X12 EDI 837/835 processing
- Real-time eligibility
- Claims adjudication
- Prior authorization
- Compliance: HIPAA, state regulations

### P1: Pharmaceutical Sidechain
- Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA)
- Track and trace
- Recall management
- Controlled substance tracking
- Compliance: FDA, DEA

### P2: Clinical Research Sidechain
- Trial data management
- Consent tracking
- Adverse event reporting
- Compliance: 21 CFR Part 11

## Plugin Interface

type SidechainPlugin interface {
    Initialize(config Config) error
    ValidateTransaction(tx Transaction) error
    ProcessBlock(block Block) error
    GetComplianceFrameworks() []string
    ValidateCompliance(data []byte) (ComplianceResult, error)
}
